assign.title: Probe tasks: tiny open-ended jobs that score the system on any model
assign.now: designing the probe set and the scoring checklist

findings.text: The branch can't be merged as it stands. `Servex/ext/openrouter/readme.md` conflicts with michael/dev (add/add; `git merge-tree michael/dev ef6e5178` reports CONFLICT). The branch's copy was taken from a worktree 34 commits behind, so keeping "ours from the branch" would delete dev's "The spend guard" and "Rule tests" sections and the `evals/rules.mjs` entry in the file list. Rebase onto michael/dev and add only the "Probe tasks" section.

Check 6 can pass when the page isn't linked. It only tests `text.includes(childSlug)` (probes.mjs:154). The seeded parent's own title already contains the run name, e.g. `probe scratch — page-blog-owls-259zv` (probes.mjs:253). So a child folder named `owls` or `blog`, the most likely names, matches the title and scores 1 with `children: []` still empty. Match the slug inside the `children:` array, not anywhere in the file.

A non-control model that runs before the control gets every failure labelled (b) for good. When no control row exists, `labelFailures` falls through to "b" (probes.mjs:311–317), and labels are written once, at append time. `--models cheap,claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` hits this, because main() runs models in the order given. The brief says to label "once the control model has run": leave the cells unlabelled when there is no control row, or label when the matrix is printed, from every row, instead of at append time.

The (c) label is only given when the spawn itself fails (probes.mjs:259–260). probes.md also counts "no hook fired (no `skill:` lines at all, no task.jsonl)" as (c), and that is exactly what both control runs show. Either implement that case or note in probes.md that it was dropped on purpose, since it is hard to tell apart from a model that simply skipped the steps.

(a) is decided as "the control fails this cell too" (probes.mjs:316), not the brief's "every model fails". That is fine as a first version, but say so in the readme so nobody reads an (a) as unanimous.

The readme calls the Haiku baseline a "candidate (a)". Both runs report `turns: 1` and not a single `skill:` line, which looks just as much like hooks or skills not reaching an agent whose cwd is a pool worktree (a (c) problem). Check that a probe agent's Skill hook writes anywhere at all before blaming the system's instructions.

The brief said to reuse the sibling `evals/rules.mjs` spawn helper if it already existed. It had landed on dev at 23:46, but the stale worktree didn't have it, so probes.mjs:51–84 is a second copy of `mcp()`, the append helper and the timestamp helper (Law 6). After rebasing, share one helper module.

Check 1 always counts the runner's own seeded `readme.md` and `page.js` as "changed", because they are untracked (probes.mjs:97). So "no files changed" can never fire, and the check parses the runner's own seed. The `.css` branch also skips the stray-backtick test that probes.md's table names (probes.mjs:104–108).

`--selftest` writes a broken page.js into the repo it runs from (probes.mjs:325). Run from the main tree, that triggers a live reload with no `hold.mjs`. It also defaults to port 62566, the private server that has since been stopped (probes.mjs:339), so check 2 now scores 0 because it can't connect, not because the page is broken. Run it in a worktree on that worktree's own server, and fail loudly if the server doesn't answer.
When there is no child page, check 6's note prints `does not name "undefined"` (see results.jsonl, row 2). Say "no child page" instead.

answer.reply: fixed: ef6e5178d..96c14742 merged michael/dev into worktree/proposal-flow (commit 96c14742), resolving Servex/ext/openrouter/readme.md by keeping dev's whole file (spend guard, rule tests, evals/rules.mjs entry) and re-adding only the Probe tasks section. results.jsonl auto-merged (union of lines).

fixed (commit 0a27de7d): checkLinkedFromParent now regexes out `children: [...]` and checks the slug only inside that array, not the whole page.js text — the seeded title can no longer make this check pass by accident.

fixed (commit 0a27de7d): a row is now appended with label:{} always (plus new `reached` and `hook_missing` fields); labelFailures only runs at print time in main(), reading every row in results.jsonl fresh, so a model that happens to run before the control shows unlabelled (not stamped b) until the control's own row exists.

fixed (commit 0a27de7d): when a run finds no task.jsonl at all (so no skill: line either, since the Skill hook only ever writes into the agent's own task.jsonl), checks 4 and 5's failures are labelled (c) at print time, not (a)/(b). Whether the Skill hook itself reaches a probe-spawned agent is still an open question, not yet checked directly -- noted in the readme rather than fixed, since answering it needs a separate proof.
fixed (commit 0a27de7d): readme.md's Probe tasks section now says plainly that (a) only ever means "the control fails this same cell too", never "every model fails it".

fixed (commit 0a27de7d): readme.md no longer calls the Haiku baseline a "candidate (a)"; it now says the result is unlabelled until it's checked whether the Skill hook even reaches an agent spawned the way a probe spawns it (no task: option, cwd inside a pool worktree) -- that check itself is left open, named explicitly rather than guessed at.

fixed (commit 0a27de7d): probes.mjs no longer keeps its own mcp()/append/timestamp helpers; it imports mcp, appendJSON (as append), nowLocal (as now), readJsonl and slug from ./rules.mjs, which now exports them for exactly this reuse.

fixed (commit 0a27de7d): checkParses now takes the two files this script itself seeds (readme.md, page.js) and excludes them before deciding "no files changed"; its .css branch also now flags a stray backtick, matching probes.md's own check-1 table.

fixed (commit 0a27de7d): --selftest now calls acquireWorktree() (the same pool/fallback the real runs use), writes the broken page inside that worktree, and scores checks 1/2 against that worktree's own server -- after a loud fetch-based ping that throws if the server never answers, instead of a silent false check-2 failure. Reran it live: both checks still score 0 against the broken page, now from inside a real worktree.
fixed (commit 0a27de7d): checkLinkedFromParent's note now says "no child page" when there's no child page at all, instead of printing `does not name "undefined"`.

assign.now: landed: probe set + runner merged; the openrouter mastermind runs the models
assign.outcome: **Probe tasks are built.** The design, [probes.md](probes.md): five tiny open-ended jobs, six checks a script decides (parses, loads clean, followed the prompt, right skills, opened-logged-landed a task, linked from its parent), and every failure labelled system / model / config. The runner, `Servex/ext/openrouter/evals/probes.mjs` (one Sonnet minion, $0.32 + proofs), runs a probe on any model in a throwaway worktree and writes one line per run to `evals/results.jsonl`; it shares its helpers with the rule tests. First control runs on Haiku: it wrote good content but no task and no skill call — unlabelled until the openrouter mastermind confirms the Skill hook reaches a probe agent (a likely config gap, not a system one). Handed to task-mastermind-openrouter, who runs the cheap models and sends the system cells to the architect.
